sources.title: Code civil — texte consolidé

version.rule: Bind the exact consolidated legal state/retrieval date (ISO date) together with the byte hash.

rights.license: Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0 for Légifrance open data

evidence.basis: Légifrance documents its open-data/API reuse regime.

sources.benchmarkFocus: Temporal/version binding: a legally correct kit must state which exact consolidated source state it used.

sources.title: Flash sécurité patient — Retranscription des prescriptions médicamenteuses

version.rule: Publication date of the selected HAS safety resource.

rights.license: French public-information reuse regime for HAS-owned public information

evidence.basis: HAS states that public information for which it owns the rights may be reused subject to source/date attribution and non-alteration, while third-party content is excluded.

sources.benchmarkFocus: Patient-safety content where a plausible simplification can become semantically unsafe if the document status or caution is distorted.

sources.title: Molière — Le Médecin malgré lui, sélection Gallica

version.rule: Exact Gallica selection page snapshot used for this first literature stress case.

rights.license: BnF/Gallica reuse conditions for digitized public-domain collections; commercial reuse may require separate conditions

evidence.basis: BnF distinguishes metadata reuse and digitized-document reuse; non-commercial reuse of digitized public-domain collections is available under stated attribution conditions.
The official Gallica selection identifies multiple historical editions, making edition identity itself part of the benchmark challenge.

sources.benchmarkFocus: Edition/source attribution: the author must not collapse several historical editions into one unversioned literary source.
